description_en: I handled IT-related administrative tasks at Hospitalhaços NGO from December 2016 to January 2017. It was my first real contact with a professional environment, and it shaped my early growth while contributing to a health-focused humanitarian cause.
description_detail_en: From December 2016 to January 2017, I volunteered as IT Assistant at Hospitalhaços NGO, doing administrative and technical work where my skills could help right away. It was my first contact with professional responsibility, contributing to a health-focused humanitarian cause with a concrete, clear mission.
